stemMd: Two concentric circles have radii 5 and 3. What is the area between them?
explanationMd: Subtract the inner area from the outer: π(25−9)=16π. An annulus is not a circle whose radius is the difference of the original radii.

distractorRationale.e: This squares the radius difference rather than subtracting squared radii.
distractorRationale.b: This doubles the difference between the circumferences: twice (10π−6π)=8π, rather than subtracting the enclosed areas.
